F Advanced Vocabulary Revision: Linking words (13 points)
Complete the sentences below with a suitable linking word. Choose from the following. (Not all the linking words will be used.)

consequently | in other words | on the one hand
for instance | in spite of | once
however | moreover | thereby
in conclusion | no sooner | unless
in order to | on the contrary | whereas
